servers.name: context7
servers.description: Look up current library documentation and code examples through Context7’s hosted MCP server. Queries are sent to Context7; no local server or API key is required for basic use.
servers.nextAction: Run /reload in Pi and open /mcp to check Context7. Ask for library docs using Context7. An optional Context7 API key provides higher rate limits.

servers.name: codebase-memory-mcp
servers.description: Persistent local repository graph and change-impact analysis through Pi’s built-in MCP support.
servers.nextAction: Run `loom init` in the repository to create a fast initial index, then run /reload in Pi and open /mcp. Loom uses Codebase Memory’s read-only analysis profile.
